meta.comment: Single ordered data source for sidebar, breadcrumbs, sidebar filter, and command palette. Node field contract per spec 02 §15: {id,title,slug,icon,parent,section,order,badge,keywords,inMenu,alias,external}. section is null for non-top-level nodes (inherited from L1 ancestor). 'parent' is null at top level. 'badge' is {type,value?} or null. 'alias' is the canonical node id this node points at (alias nodes share a slug with their canonical and are excluded from the registry count). icon = Tabler icon name (outline, 24x24, currentColor). Groups (L1 / sub-groups) carry their own node with a slug pointing at their landing leaf per spec §11 (module group click -> primary list or aliased dashboard).
